title: Escu d'ennuy (Anonymous)
desc: Anonymous, Escu d'ennuy. 3 voices (Discantus, Tenor, Contra), each on its own staff. Source: Leuven Chansonnier. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Ano3230); encoded by Jesse Rodin. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
